mrv.calculation_note: Shell Risella X 415 is marketed as a GTL-derived process/technical white oil. MRV engine-oil low-temperature pumpability testing is not required for its documented process-oil application.

open_questions: Shell Risella X 415 is marketed as a GTL-derived process/technical white oil. API lubricant base-oil Group classification is treated as Not Required for its documented application, subject to project applicability rules.
MRV low-temperature pumpability testing is treated as Not Required for the documented process-oil application. No MRV viscosity, yield stress, or test temperature is reported in the supplied TDS.
The TDS reports Noack volatility of 40 mass% at 250°C for 1 hour, ASTM D5800. Preserve this measured value despite the product's process-oil classification.
TDS DL2-13728.pdf reports density of 806 kg/m3 at 15°C, while SDS DL2-13729.pdf reports 803.5 kg/m3 at 15°C. This discrepancy requires reconciliation.
The TDS is dated 2013-02-08 and the cited SDS was revised 2018-10-26. Confirm applicable document revisions before final approval.
